quand: When a client asks for her privilege on another device, from her order summary: the button on the link’s page applies it to that device.
preheader: One click, and your privilege follows you.

lien.description: The link to open on the device of the order, valid for twenty-four hours

blocs.texte:
Hello,

You would like to enjoy your welcome privilege from another device. Open this link on the device you are ordering from: {lien}
The link stays valid for twenty-four hours. If you did not ask for anything, simply ignore this email: nothing changes.

See you soon,
the Maison Awrea Paris
